name: fabius
description: fabius — one super-skill that equips Claude end-to-end under a single Fabian stance: scout wide, strike narrow. Write lean code and lean prose, run a disciplined brainstorm→plan→TDD→verify→debug loop, design ship-grade UI, visualize data, build and orchestrate other agents, market the value, harden security (defensive), build games, and keep a persistent memory so it stops re-deriving. One install, nine coordinated zero-overlap skills: an always-on lean core, a router that dispatches by layer + machinery + model-tier, and seven engineering specialists. Capabilities: terse output, a YAGNI code ladder, root-cause debugging, design tokens + one-accent laws, data-ink charts, least-privilege agent definitions, index+log knowledge base, positioning + converting copy, STRIDE/OWASP threat-modeling, game-loop + juice. Actions: write, build, fix, debug, refactor, review, design, chart, plan, verify, remember, market, harden, play. Lean by default, never flimsy.
